title: Change price: one store refused
summary: The Change price dialog after confirming, when the App Store took $3.99 but Google Play refused: the title says 1 of 2 stores, each store's row shows its result (Changed; Not changed with why and the fix in Play Console), Steam is unchanged, and Try Google Play again retries only that store.
compare: The dialog stays open after a partial result; its title states the count ('Price changed on 1 of 2 stores') and the first line says what each store now charges.

Each store row shows its own result: App Store 'Changed' as success status with the time; Google Play as a danger row with a Not changed pill, the cause in Play Console's words (the service account lacks Manage store presence), the exact account to fix, and Open Play Console.

Try Google Play again (primary, focused) retries only the failed store with the same idempotency key; the typed confirmation isn't asked again. Close leaves the offer in a mismatch the editor shows: 'Base price $3.99 · Google Play still at $2.99' as a warning on the Price card, with the same retry.
Nothing is rolled back on the store that succeeded; the base price is recorded as $3.99 with Google Play's mismatch listed, and Activity records both outcomes.
While sending, the confirm button shows its busy state ('Changing price on 2 stores…') and the dialog can't be dismissed; each row shows a spinner until its store answers.
Phone: the same bottom sheet; the failed row's text wraps and its link stays under it.
